notes: All fifteen card faces are independently illustrated scenes; static originals are displayed whole at 2:3.
Normal card values have unique original artwork rather than repeated mascot grids. BOT avatars remain separate assets.
Card numerals remain DOM text inside the upper 30% of the image. Hidden and eliminated cards do not attach face images.
Existing deal, reveal, arithmetic and sound presentation is retained. Character-specific illustration animation is not implemented.
Actual iOS and GRAVITY rendering and audible output require device verification.
